title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-106-26二模

items.zh: 发掘内在动力,你就能坚持自己的目标。
items.en: Tap into your inner drive, and you can stick to your goals.

items.zh: 如果不良习惯持续存在,就可能对我们的健康构成威胁。
items.en: If bad habits persist, they may pose a threat to our health.

items.zh: 当下人工智能蓬勃发展,因此理性运用技术、防范潜在风险至关重要
items.en: Amid the AI boom, wise technology use and prevention of potential risks are paramount.

items.zh: 这条古老的街巷历经数百年风雨沧桑,见证了城市的兴衰更迭,在这里,一代又一代普通人用平凡的坚守书写着温暖而动人的生活故事。
items.en: Weathering centuries of trials and hardships, the old alley has witnessed the city’s waxing and waning, an alley where successive generations of ordinary people have woven warm and moving stories of life with their humble perseverance.

proverb.en: An unprecedented test of social mobility looms.
proverb.zh: 对社会流动性前所未有的考验正在冒头。
